headline: Hasan Piker, the controversial streamer seducing America's radical left
description: The 35-year-old has established himself on Twitch as one of the most-followed political commentators in the US. A socialist, he enjoys the support of the most radical wing of the Democratic Party. But that support is not unanimous, as his comments on Israel and Jews have led to accusations of antisemitism.

description: At 45, Swann Arlaud has remained true to his deeply held left-wing convictions. In May, he risked his career by signing an open letter against the billionaire Vincent Bolloré, who owns French cinema's largest funder. headline: France's debt crisis and high school protests draw global attention
description: French high school student protests have drawn major media coverage and political reactions in the US, Italy, Belgium and the UK. Only a few countries, such as Germany, wracked by its own domestic political debates, have treated the situation with restraint.

headline: Trauma endures in Paris suburb after police grenade shatters teenager's jaw
description: On September 28, 14-year-old Eden suffered a fractured jaw and lost most of his teeth after he was struck in the face by a tear-gas grenade fired at close range, just a few meters from his high school, where a protest was taking place. Students, teachers and parents spoke of their fear, anger and sense of helplessness.
